main.description: A member's own card statement (利用明細) header on the LOCAL kotoba Datom log (:meisai.stmt/*). PERSONAL financial data — held on the member's machine only, NEVER committed/pinned/published or emitted to any PDS or AT Proto firehose (G3). This lexicon documents the on-log shape; it carries NO credential and NO card number (G2 — credential-shaped keys and PAN-shaped values are unrepresentable, raised at ingest).

total.description: non-JPY statement total, integer minor units

currency.description: ISO-ish currency keyword, e.g. ':usd' (omitted for JPY)

intakeCid.description: content CID of the intake file (provenance + dedup, G5)
